aiVerification.summary: The evidence supports a Dry UV LED time-change tension comparison from normal 5s to test 3s, but the draft misstates key fields and is not ready for Ask AI.
issues: Changed factor is incorrectly populated with the source filename instead of the actual process condition change.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked as not explicit even though rows Sheet2!11 and Sheet2!12 identify Test change dry UV led 5s -> 3s and Normal (Dry UV led 5s).
Spec is incorrectly represented as > 3 in subResults; the cited row shows Spec = 1.9kgf.
Change domain includes dimension/spec, but the cited evidence primarily supports a process condition change, not a specification change.
Review title and outcome metric retain formatting noise and should be normalized.
Evidence should include Sheet2!9 or equivalent title context in addition to Sheet2!11 and Sheet2!12.
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to Dry UV LED curing/dry time changed from 5s to 3s.
Set baselineCondition to Normal (Dry UV led 5s).
Set changedCondition to Test change dry UV led 5s -> 3s.
Limit changeDomain to process condition unless additional evidence proves a spec or dimension change.
Normalize outcomeMetric to tension check or tension measurement after Dry UV LED time change.
Add Sheet2!9 as supporting evidence for the overall changed-factor context while retaining Sheet2!11 and Sheet2!12 for comparison data.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Rows Sheet2!11 and Sheet2!12 are sufficient for the baseline/test comparison values, but Sheet2!9 should be included to cite the overall change context; no user judgement is required.
